enactus.note: Enactus students are partner-programme guests, not employees: visuals carry 'Powered by Each Other' (not 'Start Strong with Schneider Electric') and captions drop #StartStrongWithSchneiderElectric. Captions are starting points; students can edit freely in their own words and language.

posts.title: Announcement
posts.note: caption is a starting point — students edit freely in their own words and language.

A.caption:
I'm going to Cape Town for One Young World 2026 to see if something I built in a classroom can survive contact with a real client.

Our Enactus team started with one problem and a lot of late nights. Next month, I get to test it in a room full of people who build things for a living.

Thank you to Schneider Electric for backing young builders before they're even in the job.

What would you ask a room of 190 countries?

#PoweredByEachOther #Enactus #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

B.caption:
I'm going to Cape Town for One Young World 2026 to find out if a small local project matters next to something built at Schneider's scale.

Our Enactus project started close to home, with one community and one problem. I want to know how ideas that size grow, and whether they need to.

Grateful to Schneider Electric for making the trip possible.

Do small projects change big systems? Tell me what you think.

#PoweredByEachOther #Enactus #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

C.caption:
I'm going to Cape Town for One Young World 2026 to pitch my idea to a room that's heard a thousand pitches before.

I've rehearsed it in front of my Enactus team more times than I can count. Now it's time to find out if it holds up.

Thank you to Schneider Electric for the chance to try.

Any advice for pitching to people who've heard it all?

#PoweredByEachOther #Enactus #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

D.caption:
I'm going to Cape Town for One Young World 2026 to be the only person from my university in a room this big, and bring my whole Enactus team with me anyway.

Every idea I'm taking there was built with them, so in a way they're coming too.

Thank you to Schneider Electric for opening this door.

Who would you bring with you into a room like that?

#PoweredByEachOther #Enactus #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

posts.title: On-Site Moment
posts.note: caption is a starting point — students edit freely in their own words and language.

A.caption:
One moment at One Young World: the badge scanner beeped, and just like that I was in the same room as people running continental-scale grids.

A few weeks ago this was a classroom project. Today it's a conversation in Cape Town.

More to share when I'm back home.

#PoweredByEachOther #Enactus #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

B.caption:
One moment at One Young World: someone twice my age asked me a follow-up question about my own project. I wasn't ready for that.

It's the best kind of surprise, being taken seriously before you feel ready.

More to share when I'm back home.

#PoweredByEachOther #Enactus #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

C.caption:
One moment at One Young World: I counted six languages at my lunch table before anyone switched to English for my benefit.

That's what 190 countries in one place feels like, up close.

More to share when I'm back home.

#PoweredByEachOther #Enactus #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

D.caption:
One moment at One Young World: I watched a delegate change her slide mid-sentence because someone in the crowd raised a hand first.

Lesson taken: the plan matters less than listening.

More to share when I'm back home.

#PoweredByEachOther #Enactus #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

posts.title: Reflection
posts.note: caption is a starting point — students edit freely in their own words and language.

A.caption:
I came in thinking the hard part was the pitch. I left knowing the hard part is doing it again on Monday, without an audience.

That's what I'm bringing home from One Young World in Cape Town, back to my Enactus team and our project.

Thank you to Schneider Electric for backing us. What's your Monday commitment?

#PoweredByEachOther #Enactus #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

B.caption:
One habit, starting now: ask the question in the room, not after it's over.

The best moments at One Young World came from people who spoke up. I'm bringing that back to my Enactus team.

Thank you to Schneider Electric for backing us. What question have you been saving for later?

#PoweredByEachOther #Enactus #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

C.caption:
I used to think "professional" meant polished. Now I think it means showing up prepared to be wrong in public.

One Young World in Cape Town changed how I see the next pitch, and the one after that.

Thank you to Schneider Electric for backing us. What did you have to unlearn?

#PoweredByEachOther #Enactus #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

D.caption:
The idea I came with is smaller than the one I'm leaving with, and that's the actual win.

Back from One Young World in Cape Town, with a bigger idea and a team ready to build it.

Thank you to Schneider Electric for backing us. What's the biggest idea you've come home with?

#PoweredByEachOther #Enactus #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

A.caption:
Before One Young World, I had a question in mind: how long until I stop double-checking everything before I send it to my manager?

Cape Town feels like a strange place to get that answer, but I'll take it. Delegates from 190 countries, and I'm guessing most of them remember their first year too.

I'm joining the Pass the Question chain with our African Explorers. What would you tell first-year you?

#StartStrongWithSchneiderElectric #PoweredByEachOther #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

B.caption:
The question I've carried through my first year: does anyone actually notice the work you do when you're not in the room?

This time I'm finally in the room, at One Young World in Cape Town, and I'm watching who notices.

I'm joining the Pass the Question chain with our African Explorers. How do you make sure good work gets seen?

#StartStrongWithSchneiderElectric #PoweredByEachOther #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

C.caption:
An honest question from my first year: was switching into this industry the right call, or did I just panic into a good-sounding job?

At One Young World, I'm asking people ten years ahead of me if they ever wondered the same thing. I have a feeling I'm not the only one.

I'm joining the Pass the Question chain with our African Explorers. Did you ever doubt a career switch?

#StartStrongWithSchneiderElectric #PoweredByEachOther #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

D.caption:
How do you tell the difference between being ready for more responsibility and just being impatient?

I'm taking that question to One Young World, to learn from people who were exactly where I am, not that long ago.

I'm joining the Pass the Question chain with our African Explorers. How did you know you were ready?

#StartStrongWithSchneiderElectric #PoweredByEachOther #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

A.caption:
If I could send one letter back to my first day at Schneider Electric, it would say: stop rehearsing your questions in the elevator. Just ask them in the room.

A year in, the best things I've learned came from questions I almost didn't ask.

What would you tell your day-one self?

#StartStrongWithSchneiderElectric #PoweredByEachOther #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

B.caption:
A letter to day-one me: the imposter feeling doesn't go away by month three. It just gets quieter.

A year into my first role at Schneider Electric, I've stopped waiting for it to disappear and started working alongside it.

What would you tell your day-one self?

#StartStrongWithSchneiderElectric #PoweredByEachOther #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

C.caption:
A letter to day-one me: nobody expects you to know everything. They just want to know you'll ask.

One year into my first job at Schneider Electric, that's the advice I wish someone had given me on the first morning.

What would you tell your day-one self?

#StartStrongWithSchneiderElectric #PoweredByEachOther #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

D.caption:
A letter to day-one me: you're going to mess up a deliverable in your first quarter. It's fine. It's actually fine.

A year in at Schneider Electric, I can say that mistake taught me more than any perfect week did.

What would you tell your day-one self?

#StartStrongWithSchneiderElectric #PoweredByEachOther #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

A.caption:
First global summit. First time realizing "international team" meant something bigger than my inbox.

Live from One Young World in Cape Town, with delegates from 190 countries. Twelve months ago I was finishing university. This week, I'm here.

More to share when I'm back home.

#StartStrongWithSchneiderElectric #PoweredByEachOther #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

B.caption:
First time in a room with 190 countries, and the only thing louder than the languages was how much everyone had to say.

Live from One Young World in Cape Town, a year into my first role at Schneider Electric.

More to share when I'm back home.

#StartStrongWithSchneiderElectric #PoweredByEachOther #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

C.caption:
I came in expecting to feel small. Instead, I finally understand the size of the thing I joined.

Live from One Young World in Cape Town, one year into my career at Schneider Electric.

More to share when I'm back home.

#StartStrongWithSchneiderElectric #PoweredByEachOther #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

Live from One Young World in Cape Town. A year ago I was writing my thesis. This week, I'm here.

I used to think my role was to execute the plan. Now I think it's to ask better questions about the plan.

That's what I'm bringing home from One Young World in Cape Town, and into my second year at Schneider Electric.

What's one thing you'd change about how you work, starting Monday?

#StartStrongWithSchneiderElectric #PoweredByEachOther #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

B.caption:
The scene that did it: watching a senior engineer admit, in front of everyone, that she didn't know the answer either.

Of everything at One Young World, that's the moment I'm bringing home. It made asking questions feel less like a weakness and more like the job.

What's a moment that changed how you work?

#StartStrongWithSchneiderElectric #PoweredByEachOther #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

C.caption:
I'm starting next week by asking my manager for one thing I never thought to ask for: more context, not more tasks.

That's my one commitment after One Young World in Cape Town.

What's the one thing you'll ask for this week?

#StartStrongWithSchneiderElectric #PoweredByEachOther #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

D.caption:
I came back smaller in the org chart and bigger in how much I think I can actually change in it.

That's my takeaway from One Young World in Cape Town, a year into my career at Schneider Electric.

What would you change if you knew you could?

#StartStrongWithSchneiderElectric #PoweredByEachOther #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

EN.caption:
I'm heading to Cape Town for One Young World 2026 with one question.

As Mobility Segment Lead in Côte d'Ivoire, I spend my days on how African cities will move, and more and more of that runs on AI. The grid is getting smarter. The real question is who gets trained to run it.

I'm going to listen, learn from delegates from 190 countries, and bring answers home to the people building it with me.

What would you want me to ask in Cape Town?

#StartStrongWithSchneiderElectric #PoweredByEachOther #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

FR.caption:
Je pars au Cap pour One Young World 2026 avec une question.

En tant que Mobility Segment Lead en Côte d'Ivoire, je travaille chaque jour sur la façon dont nos villes africaines vont se déplacer, et cela passe de plus en plus par l'IA. Le réseau devient plus intelligent. La vraie question : qui sera formé pour le piloter ?

Je vais écouter, apprendre auprès de délégués venus de 190 pays, et ramener des réponses aux équipes qui le construisent avec moi.

Quelle question voudriez-vous que je pose au Cap ?

#StartStrongWithSchneiderElectric #PoweredByEachOther #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

EN.caption:
Pass the Question. The chain reached me with this one: how do you get a team to trust AI with real decisions, not just dashboards?

My answer: train people for the jobs AI creates, not just to supervise the ones it changes. Trust comes from understanding, and understanding comes from doing the work.

But that raised a new question, and I'm passing it to @LaFortune Ngakam: how do you build that trust before the tools even reach people?

Swipe for the full exchange, and add your answer below.

#StartStrongWithSchneiderElectric #PoweredByEachOther #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

FR.caption:
Pass the Question. La chaîne m'a transmis cette question : comment amener une équipe à faire confiance à l'IA pour de vraies décisions, pas seulement pour des tableaux de bord ?

Ma réponse : former les gens pour les emplois que l'IA crée, pas seulement pour superviser ceux qu'elle transforme. La confiance vient de la compréhension, et la compréhension vient de la pratique.

Mais une nouvelle question a émergé, et je la passe à @LaFortune Ngakam : comment construire cette confiance avant même que les outils n'arrivent jusqu'aux gens ?

Faites défiler pour voir l'échange complet, et ajoutez votre réponse en commentaire.

#StartStrongWithSchneiderElectric #PoweredByEachOther #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

EN.caption:
Last month a client asked me who would run the smart system I'd just sold them. I didn't have a good answer yet.

That moment has stayed with me. As Mobility Segment Lead in Côte d'Ivoire, I see new technology arrive faster than the skills to run it. The systems are ready. The question is whether the people are.

Soon I'll be at One Young World in Cape Town, and that's the answer I'm going to look for.

Who taught you the job you do today?

#StartStrongWithSchneiderElectric #PoweredByEachOther #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

FR.caption:
Le mois dernier, un client m'a demandé qui allait faire fonctionner le système intelligent que je venais de lui vendre. Je n'avais pas encore de bonne réponse.

Ce moment ne m'a pas quitté. En tant que Mobility Segment Lead en Côte d'Ivoire, je vois les nouvelles technologies arriver plus vite que les compétences pour les faire fonctionner. Les systèmes sont prêts. La question, c'est de savoir si les gens le sont.

Bientôt, je serai à One Young World au Cap, et c'est cette réponse que je vais chercher.

Qui vous a appris le métier que vous faites aujourd'hui ?

#StartStrongWithSchneiderElectric #PoweredByEachOther #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

EN.caption:
Live from One Young World in Cape Town.

I'm walking every hallway looking for one answer: who gets trained to run what we're building? So far, the best conversations are happening between sessions, with people solving the same problem in very different places.

More to share when I'm back home.

If you could ask delegates from 190 countries one question, what would it be?

#StartStrongWithSchneiderElectric #PoweredByEachOther #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

FR.caption:
En direct de One Young World, au Cap.

Je parcours chaque couloir à la recherche d'une réponse : qui est formé pour faire fonctionner ce que nous construisons ? Pour l'instant, les meilleures conversations ont lieu entre les sessions, avec des personnes qui résolvent le même problème dans des contextes très différents.

J'en dirai plus à mon retour.

Si vous pouviez poser une question à des délégués venus de 190 pays, laquelle serait-ce ?

#StartStrongWithSchneiderElectric #PoweredByEachOther #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

EN.caption:
Back from One Young World in Cape Town, and I'm not coming home with a certificate. I'm coming home with a pilot.

Starting in December, two junior engineers on our team will work hands-on with live AI tools. I went asking who gets trained to run the AI-powered grid we're building. Cape Town gave me my answer: we train them here, inside the work.

Thank you to every delegate who pushed my thinking this week.

What's the first thing you'd teach a junior engineer about AI?

#StartStrongWithSchneiderElectric #PoweredByEachOther #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

FR.caption:
De retour de One Young World au Cap, et je ne reviens pas avec un certificat. Je reviens avec un projet pilote.

Dès décembre, deux jeunes ingénieurs de notre équipe travailleront sur des outils d'IA en conditions réelles. Je suis parti en demandant qui sera formé pour piloter le réseau alimenté par l'IA que nous construisons. Le Cap m'a donné ma réponse : on les forme ici, au cœur du travail.

Merci à tous les délégués qui ont fait avancer ma réflexion cette semaine.

Quelle est la première chose que vous apprendriez à un jeune ingénieur sur l'IA ?

#StartStrongWithSchneiderElectric #PoweredByEachOther #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

EN.caption:
Next month I'm taking one question to One Young World in Cape Town.

I work in sales distribution across Senegal and Côte d'Ivoire. My job is getting energy technology to the places that need it, not just the capitals. We talk about the African Century like it's guaranteed. I want to know what it means if the last mile still isn't solved.

I'm going to listen, learn, and come back with ideas we can actually use.

Where does "the last mile" start for you?

#StartStrongWithSchneiderElectric #PoweredByEachOther #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

FR.caption:
Le mois prochain, j'emporte une question à One Young World, au Cap.

Je travaille dans la distribution au Sénégal et en Côte d'Ivoire. Mon rôle : faire arriver la technologie énergétique là où on en a besoin, pas seulement dans les capitales. On parle du Siècle Africain comme d'une évidence. Je veux comprendre ce qu'il signifie si le dernier kilomètre n'est toujours pas résolu.

Je pars pour écouter, apprendre et revenir avec des idées concrètes.

Pour vous, où commence le « dernier kilomètre » ?

#StartStrongWithSchneiderElectric #PoweredByEachOther #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

EN.caption:
Pass the Question. The chain reached me with this one: what do you do when "available in Africa" really just means "available in the capital"?

My answer: price access for the last mile, not just the easiest one. Distribution isn't finished until it reaches the places furthest from the centre.

But a new question came up, and I'm passing it to @Ibtissam Adaha: who decides which projects even get built out that far?

Swipe for the full exchange, and add your answer below.

#StartStrongWithSchneiderElectric #PoweredByEachOther #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

FR.caption:
Pass the Question. La chaîne m'a transmis cette question : que faire quand « disponible en Afrique » signifie en réalité « disponible dans la capitale » ?

Ma réponse : tarifer l'accès pour le dernier kilomètre, pas seulement pour le plus facile. La distribution n'est pas terminée tant qu'elle n'atteint pas les endroits les plus éloignés du centre.

Mais une nouvelle question a émergé, et je la passe à @Ibtissam Adaha : qui décide quels projets sont construits jusque-là ?

Faites défiler pour voir l'échange complet, et ajoutez votre réponse en commentaire.

#StartStrongWithSchneiderElectric #PoweredByEachOther #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

EN.caption:
A distributor once told me our product "existed" in his country. It just wasn't anywhere he could actually reach it.

Working in sales distribution across Senegal and Côte d'Ivoire, I've learned that available on paper isn't the same as accessible. The last mile is where most of the real work happens.

Soon I'll take that lesson to One Young World in Cape Town.

What's "available" where you live but still out of reach?

#StartStrongWithSchneiderElectric #PoweredByEachOther #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

FR.caption:
Un distributeur m'a dit un jour que notre produit « existait » dans son pays. Il n'était simplement nulle part où il pouvait vraiment l'atteindre.

En travaillant dans la distribution au Sénégal et en Côte d'Ivoire, j'ai appris qu'être disponible sur le papier n'est pas la même chose qu'être accessible. C'est dans le dernier kilomètre que se fait l'essentiel du vrai travail.

Bientôt, j'emporterai cette leçon à One Young World, au Cap.

Qu'est-ce qui est « disponible » chez vous, mais reste hors de portée ?

#StartStrongWithSchneiderElectric #PoweredByEachOther #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

EN.caption:
Live from One Young World in Cape Town.

I'm asking everyone here the same question: what does "available" cost once you leave the capital? Delegates from the other side of the continent are describing my exact challenge. The problems rhyme.

More to share when I'm back home.

Where you are, how far from the capital does "available" stop being true?

#StartStrongWithSchneiderElectric #PoweredByEachOther #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

FR.caption:
En direct de One Young World, au Cap.

Je pose la même question à tout le monde ici : combien coûte « disponible » une fois qu'on quitte la capitale ? Des délégués venus de l'autre bout du continent décrivent exactement mon défi. Les problèmes se ressemblent.

J'en dirai plus à mon retour.

Chez vous, à quelle distance de la capitale « disponible » cesse-t-il d'être vrai ?

#StartStrongWithSchneiderElectric #PoweredByEachOther #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

EN.caption:
One Young World is over, but the work starts now.

This month I'm sharing three takeaways from Cape Town with my distribution partners, starting with the one that changed my thinking most: how we price access, not just product. I went to ask what the African Century means if the last mile still isn't solved. I came back convinced the answer starts with who can actually reach it.

Grateful to everyone who shared their stories this week.

What does "access" mean in your market?

#StartStrongWithSchneiderElectric #PoweredByEachOther #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

FR.caption:
One Young World est terminé, mais le travail commence maintenant.

Ce mois-ci, je partage trois enseignements du Cap avec mes partenaires distributeurs, en commençant par celui qui a le plus changé ma façon de voir : comment nous tarifons l'accès, pas seulement le produit. Je suis partie demander ce que signifie le Siècle Africain si le dernier kilomètre n'est toujours pas résolu. Je reviens convaincue que la réponse commence par qui peut réellement y accéder.

Merci à toutes celles et ceux qui ont partagé leur expérience cette semaine.

Que signifie « l'accès » dans votre marché ?

#StartStrongWithSchneiderElectric #PoweredByEachOther #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

EN.caption:
I'm going to Cape Town for One Young World 2026.

As a Tendering Leader in Morocco, I see how big infrastructure decisions get made, and what they end up rewarding. Tenders shape what gets built and who gets to build it. So my question for the Summit: what should the next generation of tenders actually reward?

I'll be listening to delegates from around the world and bringing the best ideas back to my team.

If you could change one thing about how projects are awarded, what would it be?

#StartStrongWithSchneiderElectric #PoweredByEachOther #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

FR.caption:
Je pars au Cap pour One Young World 2026.

En tant que Tendering Leader au Maroc, je vois comment se prennent les grandes décisions d'infrastructure, et ce qu'elles finissent par récompenser. Les appels d'offres façonnent ce qui se construit, et qui le construit. Ma question pour le Sommet : que devrait réellement récompenser la prochaine génération d'appels d'offres ?

Je vais écouter des délégués du monde entier et ramener les meilleures idées à mon équipe.

Si vous pouviez changer une seule chose dans l'attribution des projets, ce serait quoi ?

#StartStrongWithSchneiderElectric #PoweredByEachOther #SchneiderElectric #OYW26

EN.caption:
@Ndiaye Dielya passed me a question that sits right at the heart of my job: who decides which projects get built out to the places that need them most?

My answer: rewrite the tender criteria so local capability beats the lowest price. What we reward is what gets built.

Now a new question for @Lina Djellouli: once the criteria are right, who actually does the unglamorous work of building it?

Swipe for the full exchange, and add your answer below.
